introduction.title: What is hair transplant surgery?
introduction.description:
Hair transplant surgery is a surgical procedure that relocates your own hair follicles from a "donor" zone â usually the back and sides of the scalp â to areas that are bald or thinning. It works because of biology: follicles at the back of the scalp resist DHT (dihydrotestosterone), the hormone behind androgenetic alopecia (pattern hair loss). Those follicles keep their DHT-resistance after being moved, so the transplanted hair keeps growing in its new home â generally for life.

Although it's genuine surgery, a modern hair transplant in Delhi is minimally invasive: it's performed under local anaesthesia, on an outpatient basis, with tiny extraction points rather than large incisions. You stay awake and comfortable, and you go home the same day.

techniques.heading: Surgical Techniques We Offer
techniques.description: We offer the three gold-standard hair transplant techniques, each selected based on the patient's individual hair loss pattern, donor area, and expected density goals.

techniques.name: Sapphire FUE
techniques.description: Individual follicular units are extracted using micro-punches and implanted through Sapphire V-shaped blade channels. Ideal for hairlines, mid-scalp and crown.

techniques.name: DHI (Direct Hair Implantation)
techniques.description: Grafts are directly implanted using a Choi implanter pen without pre-made channels, providing higher density and the option to avoid shaving existing hair.

techniques.name: Combination FUE + DHI
techniques.description: A hybrid approach combining FUE graft extraction with DHI implantation for patients requiring large-session coverage with maximum density.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about hair transplant surgery at Ryan Clinic Delhi.

faqs.question: Is hair transplant surgery permanent?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hair transplanted from the donor zone (back of scalp) is genetically resistant to DHT â the hormone that causes male/female pattern baldness. These grafts retain their DHT-resistance even after transplantation, making results permanent.

faqs.question: How many grafts do I need?
faqs.answer: The number of grafts depends on your hair loss stage (Norwood Scale), desired density, and donor area capacity. Most patients need between 1,500â4,000 grafts. Our surgeon will give you an exact count during your free consultation.

faqs.question: Is the procedure painful?
faqs.answer: No. We use advanced local anaesthesia with buffered lidocaine and micro-injection techniques. You'll feel only a slight pressure at the anaesthesia injection points. The remainder of the procedure (4â8 hours) is completely pain-free.

faqs.question: When will I see results?
faqs.answer: Initial shedding occurs in weeks 2â4 (this is normal). New growth begins from month 3, and you'll see 60â70% of your final result by month 6â8. Full density is typically visible by 12â14 months post-surgery.

faqs.question: What is the difference between FUE and DHI?
faqs.answer: FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) extracts grafts individually and implants them into pre-made channels. DHI (Direct Hair Implantation) uses a Choi pen to implant grafts directly without channels, offering more precise angle control and better density â but at a slightly higher cost per graft.

faqs.question: Can I see before/after results of previous patients?
faqs.answer: Yes. During your free consultation, we show you our portfolio of real Delhi patients with similar hair loss patterns. We also maintain a digital gallery at our clinic.
